# story time (fabula)

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:axisStoryTime`](gmeow-axisStoryTime.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/axisStoryTime>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)

The story-time axis — narrative position in the order of happening in-universe: the fabula. Owned by a narrative reference frame; a continuity may reorder story time, and the reordering (a retcon) is a frame-scoped claim revision preserved by suppression ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).
